subject.title: fix(slack): prefer native status by default

question: Should unset Slack status reactions be suppressed only when a native assistant status thread is available, or should top-level `replyToMode: off` messages intentionally fall back to a static acknowledgement only?
rationale: The source-level fallback regression is clear, but accepting static-only progress for existing unthreaded Slack paths is a product and compatibility decision rather than a purely mechanical code choice.

options.title: Preserve Progress Fallback
options.body: Keep lifecycle reactions enabled when no `statusThreadTs` is available, while using native status by default for threaded paths that can actually call Slack.

options.title: Accept Static Ack Default
options.body: Merge the stricter default only if maintainers intentionally accept losing lifecycle progress reactions for unthreaded Slack paths and document that behavior.

options.title: Pause For Slack Progress Policy
options.body: Hold the PR until the broader Slack native-status, loading-message, and reaction-progress UX policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve Progress Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep lifecycle reactions enabled when no `statusThreadTs` is available, while using native status by default for threaded paths that can actually call Slack.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current branch and is the clearest recent routing candidate for the Slack default decision, with hsiaoa and thewilloftheshadow tied to the underlying status-reaction history.
